description: Java source code for the SnapshotStreamingActor class, an Akka actor that streams snapshots from a MongoDB persistence store in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: SnapshotStreamingActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that streams snapshots from MongoDB based on received commands.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for the actor with functions to map PIDs and entity IDs.

methods.name: propsForTest
methods.description: Creates Props for testing with mocked MongoDB client and read journal.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Closes the MongoDB client when the actor stops.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling: starts streaming on SudoStreamSnapshots, logs warnings for unexpected messages.

methods.name: createSource
methods.description: Creates a source of snapshots based on the command parameters.

methods.name: mapSnapshot
methods.description: Maps a BSON Document to a StreamedSnapshot with entity ID and JSON content.

methods.name: startStreaming
methods.description: Initiates streaming of snapshots and sends the source reference back to sender.
